Package internshipPlacementManagementSystem

Class SystemState

java.lang.Object
internshipPlacementManagementSystem.SystemState
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class SystemState
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
Method to manage and storethe global state for the InternshipPlacementManagementSystem. SystemState serves as the central container for all registered users, students, staff, company representatives, internship opportunities, applications, filter settings, and withdrawal requests It also tracks and generates unique identifiers for core entities, and provides methods to load or save the system's persistent state. SystemState is serializable to support saving and restoring application state.
